title: Anjaneya
desc: A police officer goes undercover to infiltrate the mafia and collect incriminating evidence. During his operation, he receives assistance from Divya, who begins to have romantic feelings for him.

title: Priyasakhi
desc: Sandhana Krishnan falls in love with Priya, a model. However, the couple strive to navigate challenges, as they come from contrasting families.

title: Bodinayakanur Ganesan
desc: Ganesan works for the local goon, Thiruvachi. His life takes a turn, when he falls in love with Raji. But, he has to clash with Thiruvachi who tries to marry Raji and send him to jail.

title: Narathan
desc: Vishnu is on his way to Chennai from Coimbatore to join a new company and meet his fiancée. However, his plan is jeopardised upon meeting Pavithra on a train, who is stuck in a problem.

title: Pudhu Pettai
desc: A young boy runs away when his mother dies and ends up in the company of a gangster. He soon becomes the right-hand man of his employer and makes dangerous enemies.
